# GMIUI (General Mobile GM8 MIUI)

> GMIUI is a MIUI 11 custom ROM for the General Mobile GM8 and GM8 2020 Edition Android phones (MIUI EU 11.0.10 stable, MIUI Global 11.0.7 unstable, single and dual SIM), with a Windows fastboot installer written in C#.

The ROM installs to both A and B slots over fastboot. Rooting or modding it can leave the phone stuck on the Mi logo; flashing `single/boot.img` or `dual/boot.img` to the boot partition fixes that. It is a community project, not an official General Mobile or Xiaomi release.

## Docs

- [Download page](https://projects.halit.org/general-mobile-gm8-miui/): ROM builds, changelogs, known bugs, install steps and optional mods (in Turkish)
- [GM8 MIUI Installer](https://projects.halit.org/general-mobile-gm8-miui/gm8-miui-installer/): what to download, requirements, install steps, the nine fastboot commands the installer runs and known bugs (in Turkish)
- [Blog](https://projects.halit.org/general-mobile-gm8-miui/blog/): Turkish guides on fastboot mode, opening and leaving it, drivers, ADB and fastboot setup, MIUI and GSI ROMs, root, Magisk, TWRP, the bootloader lock, developer options and VoLTE
- [Root nedir](https://projects.halit.org/general-mobile-gm8-miui/blog/root-nedir/): what root access is, its risks, checking for root and removing it (in Turkish)
- [Magisk nedir](https://projects.halit.org/general-mobile-gm8-miui/blog/magisk-nedir/): patching the boot image, modules and uninstalling Magisk (in Turkish)
- [TWRP nedir](https://projects.halit.org/general-mobile-gm8-miui/blog/twrp-nedir/): the custom recovery, installing it with fastboot and the GM8 restore steps (in Turkish)
- [Bootloader kilidi açma](https://projects.halit.org/general-mobile-gm8-miui/blog/bootloader-kilidi-acma/): OEM unlocking, fastboot flashing unlock and relocking (in Turkish)
- [Geliştirici seçenekleri açma](https://projects.halit.org/general-mobile-gm8-miui/blog/gelistirici-secenekleri-acma/): enabling developer options, USB debugging and OEM unlocking (in Turkish)
- [VoLTE nedir](https://projects.halit.org/general-mobile-gm8-miui/blog/volte-nedir/): voice over LTE, IMS and why custom ROMs can lose it (in Turkish)
- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/general-mobile-gm8-miui/blob/main/README.md): features, supported devices, installer usage and the fastboot commands it runs
- [Installer source](https://github.com/halitsever/general-mobile-gm8-miui/blob/main/src/GM8%20MIUI/Form1.cs): the WinForms code that runs the fastboot flash sequence
